rationale: The assistant correctly identified the drying heater circuit, thermal cut-out and heater as likely causes, forbade bypassing the cut-out, and escalated to an engineer without naming a part. However, it repeated the 60°C wash test in nearly every turn, which added little once the drying-only fault was already well supported. It also downplayed the interrupted-cycle link ('may simply be a coincidence') and never asked for the exact model or mentioned lint or airflow blockage as a cause of overheating. The first reply also pointed the customer to the pump filter, which was less relevant once the symptoms were known.
